# Are your sponsorship slots priced right?

> Free ad slot sell-through planner for newsletter and podcast publishers. Paste past runs to see sell-through, unsold revenue, whether to raise or lower your price, booking pace for the next issue and last-minute floor math. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
